name: robots/leggedrobotics__nav-suite
title: nav-suite depth navigation (Anymal D, Isaac Lab)
intro: nav-suite depth navigation (Anymal D, Isaac Lab), adapted from leggedrobotics/nav-suite. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
